uutiset.t: McIlroy misses out on PGA Tour player of the year shortlist - who is in?
uutiset.s: Rory McIlroy has missed out on being shortlisted for the PGA Tour's Player of the Year award, despite successfully defending his title at The Masters.

uutiset.t: Wasteful Arsenal held by Borussia Dortmund
uutiset.s: Arsenal were punished for failing to take their chances for the second game in a row as Maximilian Beier clinched a 1-1 draw for Borussia Dortmund in the Champions League.

uutiset.t: Poch fumes at Yoro red and thinks Szoboszlai goal shouldn't have stood
uutiset.s: Mauricio Pochettino has heavily criticised VAR in Manchester United's loss at Liverpool after Leny Yoro's red card was overturned, while the Argentine believes Dominik Szoboszlai’s opener should not have stood.

uutiset.t: Hibernian finally register home win after battling past Dundee
uutiset.s: Hibernian ended their long wait for a Premiership home win after overcoming Dundee 2-1 at Easter Road.

uutiset.t: Norwich hit back to hold QPR
uutiset.s: Norwich's impressive run of victories came to an end as QPR held them to a 1-1 draw at Carrow Road.

uutiset.t: Armstrong nets twice in Wolves win
uutiset.s: Adam Armstrong's brace made it six goals in six games to give dominant Wolves a 3-0 win over Derby in the Sky Bet Championship at Molineux.
Sydie Peck equalised in the 90th minute as Sheffield United came from behind to secure a 1-1 Championship draw with Southampton at Bramall Lane.

uutiset.t: Preston off bottom after thrashing Cardiff
uutiset.s: Preston's revival under new boss Graham Alexander picked up more pace as they took Cardiff's unbeaten home league record with a 4-0 triumph in the Welsh capital that moved them off the bottom of the Championship.

uutiset.t: Charlton sweep to victory over Lincoln
uutiset.s: Charlton swept Lincoln aside at The Valley with an impressive 4-0 Sky Bet Championship victory.

uutiset.t: Bristol City rally to hold Wrexham
uutiset.s: Bristol City stopped the rot at home by claiming a welcome point in a 1-1 draw with Wrexham.

uutiset.t: Lankshear steers Boro back to the top of the Championship
uutiset.s: Will Lankshear was back among the goals as Middlesbrough cemented their position at the top of the Championship with a 2-1 win over Swansea City.

uutiset.t: Parker still winless as Portsmouth beat West Ham
uutiset.s: Scott Parker's winless start to life as West Ham boss continued as Odin Bailey netted his first Portsmouth goal in a 1-0 victory at Fratton Park.

uutiset.t: Sheehan to miss Ireland's Nations Championship finale after two-game ban
uutiset.s: Ireland captain Dan Sheehan will miss Friday's Nations Championship fifth-place play-off against Australia after being handed a two-game ban for his red card against South Africa.

uutiset.t: Villa beaten late on at Galatasaray as winless run continues
uutiset.s: Aston Villa's winless run extended to six games as a late Deniz Gul's header saw them beaten 1-0 by Galatasaray in the Champions League league phase.

uutiset.t: Boro win to go top; West Ham beaten by Portsmouth - EFL highlights
